slug: 2025-12-15 South Africa plans Intelligent Population Register in proposed civil registration reform

systems.country_label: Intelligent Population Register (IPR), to replace the National Population Register

note: A proposal, not a system in use: the draft revised White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection (gazetted about 12 Dec 2025, comment to 31 Jan 2026) proposes a population register as the basis of digital identity and intends to make birth and death registration mandatory through digital channels; it does not say how or where an office records an event, so no civil-class fact is taken.
